# Alberta Pressure Washing

> Alberta Pressure Washing is a locally owned, fully licensed and insured exterior cleaning company serving Edmonton and surrounding communities across Alberta, Canada. We provide professional pressure washing, soft washing, and exterior cleaning for homes and businesses, with upfront, no-obligation quotes and no hidden fees.

Phone: 780-680-3753
Website: https://albertapressurewashing.ca
Service area: Edmonton and surrounding areas in Alberta, Canada (Edmonton, Sherwood Park, St. Albert, Spruce Grove, Leduc, Fort Saskatchewan, Calgary)
Business type: Service-area pressure washing and exterior cleaning company
Rating: 5.0 stars on Google (53+ reviews)

## Services

- [Pressure Washing](https://albertapressurewashing.ca/pressure-washing): Deep cleaning for driveways, walkways, patios, and other hard surfaces across Alberta.
- [House Washing](https://albertapressurewashing.ca/house-washing): Gentle soft washing that safely removes dirt, mold, and algae from siding and stucco.
- [Roof Cleaning](https://albertapressurewashing.ca/roof-cleaning): Safe soft-wash roof cleaning that removes moss, algae, and black streaks without damage.
- [Gutter Cleaning](https://albertapressurewashing.ca/gutter-cleaning): Clearing clogged gutters and downspouts to protect your roof and foundation.
- [Concrete Cleaning](https://albertapressurewashing.ca/concrete-cleaning): Restoring driveways, sidewalks, patios, and garage floors.
- [Fence Cleaning](https://albertapressurewashing.ca/fence-cleaning): Bringing weathered wood and vinyl fences back to life.
- [Commercial Pressure Washing](https://albertapressurewashing.ca/commercial-pressure-washing): Storefronts, warehouses, parking lots, and buildings kept clean and professional.
- [Power Washing](https://albertapressurewashing.ca/power-washing): Power washing services for driveways, siding, decks, and more.
- [All Services](https://albertapressurewashing.ca/services): Overview of every service we offer.
